#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353;

ll pow_mod(ll a, ll n) {
    ll res = 1;
    while (n) {
        if (n & 1) res = res * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        n >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

vector<vector<ll>> enumFIF(int n) {
    vector<ll> f(n+1), invf(n+1);
    f[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) f[i] = f[i-1] * i % MOD;
    invf[n] = pow_mod(f[n], MOD-2);
    for (int i = n-1; i >= 0; i--) invf[i] = invf[i+1] * (i+1) % MOD;
    return {f, invf};
}

ll C(int n, int r, const vector<vector<ll>>& fif) {
    if (n < 0 || r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    return fif[0][n] * fif[1][r] % MOD * fif[1][n-r] % MOD;
}

int main() {
    int n, K, L;
    cin >> n >> K >> L;
    auto fif = enumFIF(10000);
    ll ans = 0;
    for (int i = K; i <= n; i++) {
        ll base = pow_mod(2, i) * fif[0][i] % MOD * fif[0][i] % MOD * fif[1][2*i+1] % MOD;
        ll m = C(n, i, fif);
        for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
            ll term = base * m % MOD * C(n-i, n-j, fif) % MOD;
            if ((j - i) % 2 == 0) {
                ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
            } else {
                ans = (ans - term) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    if (ans < 0) ans += MOD;
    cout << ans * L % MOD << endl;
    return 0;
}
